{{Current events|year=2019|month=02|day=20|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Arts and culture
*The [[Southern Poverty Law Center]] reports a 30 percent increase in U.S. hate groups over the past four years with a 7% increase in 2018 alone. [https://www.npr.org/2019/02/20/696217158/u-s-hate-groups-rose-sharply-in-recent-years-watchdog-group-reports (NPR)]

;International relations
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]], [[2019 shipping of humanitarian aid to Venezuela]]
**The [[Venezuelan Navy]] closes its maritime borders with the [[Dutch Caribbean]] islands of [[Aruba]], [[Curaçao]] and [[Bonaire]] ahead of the planned entry of international [[humanitarian aid]] into [[Venezuela]] on February 23, which [[Nicolás Maduro]] considers a precursor to invasion. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/02/20/americas/venezuela-closes-border-intl/index.html (CNN)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Dhaka fire]]
**A fast-moving fire has swept through a historic district of [[Bangladesh]]'s capital [[Dhaka]], killing at least 80 and wounding 50 others. [https://edition-m.cnn.com/2019/02/20/asia/dhaka-apartment-fire-intl/index.html?r=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.com%2F (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*''[[Timbs v. Indiana]]''
**The [[Supreme Court of the United States|U.S. Supreme Court]], in a unanimous 9–0 decision, rules the [[Eighth Amendment to the United States Constitution|8th Amendment]]'s prohibition on excessive fines [[Incorporation of the Bill of Rights|applies to state and local governments]], as well as the federal government. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/courts_law/supreme-court-says-constitutional-protection-against-excessive-fines-applies-to-state-actions/2019/02/20/204ce0d4-3522-11e9-af5b-b51b7ff322e9_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[History of the Conservative Party (UK)|History of the UK Conservative Party]]
**Three British [[Member of Parliament (United Kingdom)|MPs]] – [[Anna Soubry]], [[Sarah Wollaston]] and [[Heidi Allen]] – defect from the [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative Party]] to [[The Independent Group]], citing their opposition to [[Brexit]] and the party's adoption of [[United Kingdom Independence Party|UKIP]] policies. This brings the total number of The Independent Group MPs to eleven following recent defections from [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/feb/20/tory-mps-defect-independent-group-soubry-allen-wollaston (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2019 North Korea–United States Hanoi Summit]]
**The [[UN Security Council Sanctions Committee on North Korea|United Nations Security Council Sanctions Committee]] permits those [[North Korea]]ns on its global travel ban list to travel to [[Hanoi]], [[Vietnam]], for the second summit meeting with [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-usa-un/u-n-permits-north-koreans-to-travel-to-vietnam-for-trump-summit-idUSKCN1Q92KF (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*One surviving female specimen of the Fernandina [[Galápagos tortoise]] species, which was thought to be extinct for more than 100 years, is found. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2019/02/20/galapagos-rare-tortoise-species-considered-extinct-until-now/2930134002/ (''USA Today'')]
